widget_mechanic: After applying ≥2 filters, an active-chip bar shows what is currently applied. Agent must verify each required chip is present (and no extras) before treating the result set as the answer.

source_inspiration.instruction: Browse the latest negative reviews from players with over 100 hours of playtime for the game that won the 2023 VR Game of the Year Award.
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Wrong values or constraint violation: The agent selected the Playtime filter “Over 1 hour” while the task required reviews from players with over 100 hours (or the closest available high-playtime bucket).
